text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated RPM for model-family `tide-13b` detected in us-west-2. 95th p50 latency > 2.2s, error rate spike to 3.8%. Top tenants: tenant-42, tenant-beta.
alex_oncall: paging. I see spikes on the dashboards, routing queue backing up. Can someone triage capacity vs noisy tenants?
sam_sre: I'm on it. Pulling per-tenant RPM and recent deploys. Looks like a sudden traffic burst from tenant-42 with many streaming requests.
lee_platform: Checking infra — GPU pool util for tide-13b nodes at 94%. KV cache hit rate dropped from 88% -> 62% in last 10m.
jane_product: Any customer-facing errors reported?
miguel_support: Receiving a handful of 502/timeout reports from tenant-42's endpoints, others mostly degraded latency. Ticket IDs: #7821, #7823.
alex_oncall: Plan: apply a soft RPM cap on tide-13b to protect general SLOs, and disable function-calling for that family as a fast mitigation to reduce processing per-request. Will notify customers if needed.
sam_sre: Agreed. Proposed: `rpm: 1200 -> 400` for tide-13b for 30m, then reassess. Also `funcall: disable` toggle for that model family.
lee_platform: Ready to apply. Commands below (internal):
```
redwoodctl quota set --model tide-13b --rpm 400 --duration 30m --reason "emergency softcap to protect latency"
redwoodctl feature-toggle set --model tide-13b --disable-funcall true --reason "reduce per-request compute"
```
deploy-bot: Executing quota change: request_id=Q-20260402-993
deploy-bot: Quota update applied. tide-13b rpm=400 (effective 1768812365), duration=30m. :white_check_mark:
lee_platform: Funcall toggle applied (effective 1768812380). Observability note: expect some differences in response shape for customers using tools.
sam_sre: Monitoring metrics... GPU util dropping to 72% within 2m, request queue length halved. Error rate trending down to 0.7%.
miguel_support: Confirmed fewer new 502 reports. Customer tenant-42 still seeing latency for in-flight sessions but new requests are behaving better.
jane_product: Heads-up: product team flagged one integration that relies on tool-calls for structured output. We should notify affected customers ASAP and offer fallback guidance.
alex_oncall: Noted. @miguel_support please open an advisory to tenant-42 and the integration owners: explain temporary funcall suspend and suggest resumable flows or using `tide-7b` with funcall enabled if needed.
miguel_support: Will do, drafting now.
sam_sre: Suggest routing policy change for heavy tenants: prefer lower-cost smaller model `tide-7b` when funcall required, or enable canary routing.
lee_platform: I can add a temporary route weight: `route set --from tenant-42 --to tide-7b --weight 30% --reason "mitigate tide-13b spike"` — apply if approved.
alex_oncall: Approve 30% to tide-7b. Keep canary gradual.
deploy-bot: Route change applied (effective 1768812460). :white_check_mark:
sam_sre: Post-mitigation metrics: p50 latency down 35%, p95 back under 1.9s, overall error rate 0.4%. KV cache warming still catching up but improving.
jane_product: Product OK with the temporary plan. We'll coordinate communication after postmortem.
alex_oncall: Owner handoff: I'm going to hand this to @sam_sre for the shift. Follow-ups: (1) run targeted eval on tide-7b output quality for flagged integrations, (2) investigate why KV cache dropped, (3) consider tenant-specific burst controls.
sam_sre: Acknowledged. I'll keep monitoring and start a post-incident thread with perf graphs + timeline.
miguel_support: Advisory sent to tenant-42 and integration owners. Noted that funcall-dependent flows may have degraded; offered workarounds and ETA for review.
lee_platform: Creating incident task: INC-2026-042-54. Adding perf dump and `/var/logs/inference/*` extraction for the time window.
alex_oncall: Thanks all. Summary: applied soft RPM cap (1200->400) and disabled funcall for tide-13b, added 30% route weight to tide-7b for tenant-42. Immediate customer impact reduced. Handoff complete to @sam_sre. :checkered_flag:
sam_sre: Will follow up with a detailed postmortem and recommended permanent mitigations (prefetch/KV improvements, tenant burst quotas, funcall cost accounting).
